question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a pink present, Bob has a purple present, and Claire has a teal present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) pink present
(B) purple present
(C) teal present
solution:
Present colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: pink, purple, teal
1. Bob–Claire: pink, teal, purple
2. Claire–Alice: purple, teal, pink
3. Alice–Claire: pink, teal, purple
Bob has the teal present, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
